architecture: event-driven recurrent predictive state, no label-identified relations or fixed causal path
scientific_question: Can a bounded native, query-blind predictor learn from consecutive observed transitions and retain useful information across A-B-A task switches, beating similarly informed controls without graph labels?
research_truth: The hidden dynamics generator is evaluator-only; model sees only observations x(t), observes x(t+1) as its self-supervised prediction target, and never receives causal edges, task identifiers or intermediate causal answers.

frozen_design.world: four observable bounded continuous state coordinates with independently sampled hidden sparse transition operators and exogenous pulses
frozen_design.switch_sequence: context A 24 ticks, context B 24 ticks, context A 24 ticks; context identity never passed to learner
frozen_design.source_family: source-free deterministic xorshift32 world and state permutations; out-of-training stress changes sparsity and signed influence structure
frozen_design.observation: Only state vectors at consecutive ticks. No hidden graph, edge sign, context ID or future query.
frozen_design.readout: Predict one-step next state; two-step rollout composes solely through the model's own dynamics
frozen_design.learning: Streaming next-observation predictive-error updates; no heldout tuning; fixed train-only rates/configs
frozen_design.hard_false_positives: Report adverse sign/activation predictions rather than suppressing negatives

comparison: same observational streams for all arms
trained recurrent/EMA and local-state controls with explicitly reported parameter and memory sizes
frozen initial A vs returning A error and later-B interference
metrics: MAE and MSE by A1/B/A2 phases
persistent bytes, active params, per-transition arithmetic operations, CPU time
native capability claims withheld until independently validated

qualification.development_signal: At least 5% relative MSE gain versus strongest fully trained resource-matched control in stress and no phase A2 degradation beyond 10%; memory removal worsens predictive loss by 10% or more; no compute/memory nonregression; positive remains development-only.
qualification.negative: Any failed hard gate, report exact values; do not tune on evaluation.
qualification.invalid: Generator leakage, hidden task labels, unbounded memory, non-independent streams, after-result threshold change or unfair comparator.
